definition: Wanting revenge and ready to punish someone who offended you.
author: James Matthew Barrie
quote: “You have been wonderfully quick,” her father retorted, with a vindictive politeness that was quite thrown away upon her.
example_sentence: Losing at Monopoly brings out my brother's vindictive streak.
